speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when these mental status changes began and if you've experienced any recent fever, head trauma, or medication changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has she experienced any recent fevers, headaches, or neck stiffness? I would also like to know if she has had any recent urinary symptoms or respiratory infections.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Mental status changes. I also have Increased confusion, Lethargy.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CT_Head
REQUEST TEST: CBC
REQUEST TEST: CMP

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the normal CT and labs, I am concerned about metabolic or infectious causes not yet ruled out, so I will check for infection and liver function. REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_Puncture
REQUEST TEST: Ammonia_Level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lumbar Puncture: Normal cell count, protein, and glucose; no organisms identified. Ammonia Level: Normal.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Do you have a history of seizures, and have you observed any rhythmic jerking movements or staring spells recently?
REQUEST TEST: EEG

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: EEG: No epileptiform discharges or seizure activity detected. Background slowing consistent with metabolic encephalopathy.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the background slowing on the EEG and her significant smoking history, I need to rule out hypoxia or carbon monoxide poisoning. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Arterial Blood Gas: pH 7.40, PaCO2 40 mmHg, PaO2 88 mmHg, HCO3 24 mEq/L, O2 Saturation 96% on room air. Carbon Monoxide Oximetry: Carboxyhemoglobin <1%.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal ABG and CO levels, I must rule out other toxic exposures or vascular causes. Do you have a history of alcohol use, and have you noticed any new focal neurological deficits such as weakness or speech difficulties? REQUEST TEST: Toxicology_Screen

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of autoimmune diseases, and have you experienced any recent weight loss or night sweats? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: No acute infarction, mass, or hemorrhage. Mild nonspecific white matter hyperintensities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of alcohol use disorder or poor nutritional intake, and have you noticed any ataxia, eye movement abnormalities, or confusion that worsens with eye movements? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Thiamine_Level
